topic: V/Q Mismatch and pulmonary gas exchange

source.title: Lung Structure and the Intrinsic Challenges of Gas Exchange
source.whyItFits: Open physiology review that explains ventilation-perfusion matching, the acinus as the gas-exchange unit, and how hypoxic pulmonary vasoconstriction preserves matching. The classic Petersson and Glenny ERJ review is not in PMC. West-zone numbers and a 0.8 ratio are not stated in the passages used.

notes: Stored pulmonary-embolism gas-exchange note was 659 characters and was not accepted.
